zh.title: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士在2026年第二季度總共完成了237架飛機的交付作業。
在公布第二季度的交付數據之際，空中巴士依然保持全年總計交付870架飛機的既定目標。
Simple Flying報導分析，空中巴士能否維持永續的產能提升步調，對於其能否順利實現全年度870架飛機的交付目標而言至為關鍵。
保持永續的生產提速步調，將是空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標的要務。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, Airbus achieved a total of 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026.
Along with the second-quarter delivery figures, Airbus confirmed that it is keeping its full-year target of 870 aircraft deliveries.
Simple Flying highlighted that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be a crucial factor for Airbus as it seeks to achieve its delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year.
The delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year remains the focus as Airbus works to maintain its sustainable production ramp-up.

zh.title: 波音完成737-7與737-10規劃認證飛行測試
zh.summary: 波音公司已完成旗下737 MAX系列最小型737-7與最大型737-10機型的規劃認證飛行測試。波音目前正推動開發保證審查與系統安全評估工作，並提交最終資料予美國聯邦航空局進行審查，維持預計於2026年取得認證、2027年開始向客戶交付機隊的時程目標。
body: 波音公司在第二季相關公告中確認，旗下737 MAX系列中最小型的737-7與最大型的737-10兩款衍生機型，均已順利完成規劃的認證飛行測試。這項進展意味著波音公司在完成該系列機型的核心飛行測試階段後取得重要里程碑，並持續為後續取得監管認證進行準備。
在737-10機型的具體測試數據方面，波音指出該機型在規劃的認證飛行測試中，累計執行了976架次的測試飛行，總計飛行時間超過2,060個小時，同時也完成了大約1,040個小時的地面測試工作。相關測試涵蓋了飛機系統與極端環境條件下的營運驗證。
隨著認證飛行測試階段正式結束，該客機發展計畫的工作重心已全面轉移至後續程序，包括完成剩餘的開發保證審查（DAR）與系統安全評估（SSA），並準備將最終相關資料報告提交予美國聯邦航空局（FAA）進行正式監管審查。
關於目前開發保證審查與安全評估的具體進度，波音說明指出，第3階段開發保證審查（DAR 3）已經正式完成，第4階段開發保證審查（DAR 4）的完成率則達到60%，而系統安全評估（SSAs）整體進度目前已完成了32%。
波音團隊透過本次發布再度重申，737-7與737-10兩款機型劃定的發展時程維持不變，計畫於2026年取得監管機構的型別認證，並預估在2027年正式開始向客戶交付首批客機，持續推進後續的各項行政與監管審查工作。

en.title: Boeing Completes Planned Certification Flight Tests for 737-7 and 737-10
en.summary: Boeing has completed planned certification flight testing for both the smallest 737-7 and largest 737-10 aircraft variants within its 737 MAX family. Following the conclusion of the test flights, the manufacturer is shifting its focus toward finalizing remaining development assurance reviews and system safety assessments before submitting the complete deliverables to the Federal Aviation Administration for official regulatory review. Boeing reiterated that both aircraft variants remain on track to receive certification in 2026, followed by initial customer deliveries starting in 2027.
body: Boeing has officially completed planned certification flight testing for both the 737-7 and the 737-10 aircraft variants, bringing an end to the planned flight test campaign for the smallest and largest members of the 737 MAX family. The aircraft manufacturer confirmed in its second-quarter 2026 reporting that flight testing for both models reached its conclusion as of July 2026.

Providing additional details on the 737-10 flight test program, Boeing noted that the planned certification flight testing campaign logged a total of 976 test flights. Across the comprehensive testing campaign, the test aircraft accumulated over 2,060 flight hours and approximately 1,040 ground test hours to validate onboard systems and performance.

Following the successful completion of all planned flight tests, Boeing stated that the aircraft program focus is now shifting toward finalizing the remaining development assurance reviews and system safety assessments. The manufacturer will compile and submit these final deliverables to the United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for formal regulatory review and approval.

Boeing outlined the exact status of its remaining regulatory submittals, confirming that Development Assurance Review 3 (DAR 3) is already finished. Furthermore, the planemaker reported that Development Assurance Review 4 (DAR 4) is currently 60% complete, while the required system safety assessments (SSAs) currently stand at 32% completion.

Reaffirming its commercial program timeline, the Boeing team reiterated that both the 737-7 and 737-10 variants remain on track for regulatory certification in 2026. The company continues to anticipate that initial customer deliveries for both aircraft models will commence on schedule in 2027.
